## Finance Constraint Reminder
- Monetary values in this layer: `Decimal` — never `float`
- All PII fields: synthetic data only in tests
- Regulatory fields: format, presence, value validated

---

## Identity & Auth Fields

| Field | Type | Format | PII | Regulatory | Boundary Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| access_token | String | JWT (3-part, dot-separated) | No | No | Expired, malformed, revoked, null |
| refresh_token | String | Opaque, min 32 chars | No | No | Expired, already used, null |
| session_id | UUID | RFC 4122 v4 | No | Yes (audit) | Null, duplicate, expired |
| mfa_code | String | 6-digit numeric TOTP | No | No | Expired (>30s), invalid, null, replay |
| user_id | UUID | RFC 4122 v4 | No (audit-sensitive) | Yes (audit) | Null, non-existent |
| <!-- AGENT: add from BRD --> | | | | | |

## KYC / Document Fields

| Field | Type | Format | PII | Regulatory | Boundary Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| document_type | Enum | passport, driving_licence, national_id | No | Yes | Unsupported type, null |
| document_number | String | Country-specific format | Yes | Yes | Null, empty, invalid format, duplicate |
| document_expiry | Date | ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD | No | Yes | Expired (yesterday), expires today, future, null |
| date_of_birth | Date | ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD | Yes | Yes (AML: 18+) | Under 18, exactly 18, null, future date |
| full_name | String | Max 100 chars, Unicode | Yes | Yes | Mismatch vs account, null, empty, special chars |
| nationality | String | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 | No | Yes | Invalid code, null |
| <!-- AGENT: add from BRD / Daon spec --> | | | | | |

## AML / Fraud Fields

| Field | Type | Format | PII | Regulatory | Boundary Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| risk_score | Integer | 0–100 | No | Yes | 0, 100, null, out of range |
| pep_flag | Boolean | true/false | No | Yes | null |
| watchlist_match | Boolean | true/false | No | Yes | null |
| transaction_count_1h | Integer | Non-negative | No | Yes | 0, at threshold, above threshold, null |
| <!-- AGENT: add from AML policy --> | | | | | |

## Boundary Conditions Summary

| Field | Null | Empty | Min | Max | Invalid Format | Edge Case |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| access_token | Test | N/A | N/A | N/A | Malformed JWT | Expired, revoked |
| document_expiry | Test | N/A | Any past date | Any future date | YYYY/MM/DD | Expired yesterday, expires today |
| date_of_birth | Test | N/A | 1900-01-01 | Today - 18 years | YYYY/MM/DD | Exactly 18, under 18 |
| mfa_code | Test | Test | 000000 | 999999 | Non-numeric, 5 digits | Replay within 30s window |
| <!-- AGENT: complete --> | | | | | | |

## Synthetic Data Generators Required

| Field | Generator | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| full_name | `synthetic_name()` | Non-real, passes format validation |
| date_of_birth | `synthetic_dob(min_age=18)` | Valid, 18+ only for happy path |
| document_number | `synthetic_document_number(type)` | Valid format per document type |
| user_id | `uuid.uuid4()` | Standard |
| session_id | `uuid.uuid4()` | Standard |
